description: Decides when/how to route SDLC work to Antigravity/Gemini (tiering, cost discipline, digest handling, verification gates).

evals.name: Bulk migration above break-even gets delegated with cost discipline
evals.prompt: I need to migrate all callers in this repo from APIv1 to APIv2 per MIGRATION.md -- there are about 40 call sites across the codebase. Should I delegate this to Antigravity?
evals.expected_output: Recommends delegation (this is squarely bulk/repetitive migration work, clearly above the break-even per the Cost discipline section). Names the delegation mechanism (agy-delegate, or the antigravity-delegate subagent for zero-Claude-token file writes), a sensible tier (pro for a migration needing correctness, or explains tier choice), --dir <repo-root> to let agy read real files instead of pasting them, and running on a dedicated branch/worktree with a diff review before merging (Safety for write tasks). States the digest-only instruction (end with a ===DIGEST=== block) as the cost lever, not raw output. Does not silently skip the break-even framing.

evals.name: Tiny one-off edit stays below break-even, not delegated
evals.prompt: Can you rename the variable 'usr' to 'user' in one function in src/auth.py?
evals.expected_output: Recommends doing this directly, not delegating -- explicitly names this as below the break-even (small, self-contained, judgement-light per the Cost discipline / When NOT to Use guidance) where delegation would be a net loss. Does not reach for agy-delegate or the antigravity-delegate subagent for this task.

evals.name: Migration-onboarding request routes to the sibling skill, not handled here
evals.prompt: I want to migrate my whole Claude Code setup -- skills, memory, MCP servers -- over to Antigravity so I can use agy going forward. How do I do that?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a one-time config/setup migration, not an ongoing delegation task, and points to the sibling migrate-to-antigravity skill / the /antigravity-kit:migrate command instead of trying to answer it as an antigravity-skill delegation question -- matching the skill's own 'When NOT to Use' section, which names migrate-to-antigravity explicitly for this exact scenario.

evals.name: Grep-verify an uncertain agy-media digest fact
evals.prompt: You ran `agy-media ./meeting.wav "decisions and owners"` via the antigravity skill. The digest it returned says: 'New hire (name unclear, sounds like Kasimir or Kazimierz) starts Monday, owns the billing migration, timeline end of Q3. Flagged uncertain: the name, around timestamp 00:14:28-00:14:32.' The full transcript was written to ./meeting.transcript.md in the current directory. Per the skill's own documented instruction, verify the uncertain name before reporting it as fact.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the skill's documented verification step (grep the timestamp out of the transcript file, via Bash(grep:*) or an equivalent read-only file-inspection tool) rather than trusting the digest summary as-is, and correctly reports the verified name as 'Kazimierz' (confirmed by Bob immediately after Alice's uncertain guess at 00:14:32), not 'Kasimir'. Regression check added after Codex review on PR #349 found allowed-tools was missing Bash(grep:*)/Grep despite the skill's own body instructing this exact grep step.
